decisions.reason: Changing the landing-page implementation stack does not alter the requirement to provide a sign-up button.
The source changes the implementation stack but does not change the landing-page copy or content structure.
The choice of plain HTML plus Tailwind does not change which hero sentence should receive emphasis.
The implementation-stack change leaves the selected concepts, theme, colors, typography, and unresolved logo treatment unchanged.
The source explicitly concerns turning the landing-page design into the live website and does not change the separate SaaS admin workspace shell.
The website build-stack decision does not specify or change the footer's content, sharing behavior, or presentation requirement.
